verdict.rationale: Column offers API-level KYC/KYB with manual-review support and role-based dashboard access, but there is no evidence of an actual ops-facing onboarding queue UI showing why an application is pending, a document-upload flow, or a clear split between ops-owned vs. bank-owned decisions. Missing for 10: dedicated onboarding queue/dashboard view, pending-reason surfacing, document submission workflow, explicit ops-vs-bank decision boundary documentation.
